notes: Fund-clearing loop 2026-10-19 (vga). Income: 10-Q 2026-03-31 (0001193125-26-219643) prints 'Total investment income 20,906 22,890 ... Total expenses 10,786 11,994 Net investment income (loss) 10,120 10,896'; tagged us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNet 20,906,000 (the total), InvestmentIncomeOperatingAfterExpenseAndTax 10,120,000 (net) and OperatingExpenses 10,786,000. The shared map read InvestmentIncomeNet as net investment income in every quarter (total investment income was blank). InvestmentIncomeNet is read as total investment income and OperatingExpenses as total expenses; net investment income then comes from InvestmentIncomeOperatingAfterExpenseAndTax.
